Author: Serpens66
Name: Pathfinding
Description: Faster and smarter unit movement: shared group routes, better commands, gate routing, Assassin climbing, formations, command queue and synchronized troop movement.

Changes: Fast individual and group routes now straighten back-and-forth diagonal bends when units can take the straight section for the same or lower movement cost.
On clear ground, newly calculated direct routes keep their heading for longer, with the same number of steps.
After a multiplayer resync, pending extended Shift orders are cleared. The current order and the game's own queued commands continue.

With the drawbridge option enabled, your units and allies can use side exits from lowered drawbridges at open gates, even when a building or moat blocks the straight landing. Very complex layouts with several separate landings can still use the previous routing.
Reduced the time spent updating drawbridge routes during play.
Keep Shift orders synchronized in multiplayer. If a player cannot run the extended command queue, everyone uses the game's standard orders for that match. Requires APIShared 0.58.2.

With fast group or individual routing enabled, newly calculated ground routes can take a closer line around obstacles instead of making wide, angular detours. This also applies to workers walking to their jobs. A route may use up to 5% more steps when that noticeably reduces the detour across the map.

The extra route check has a fixed work limit and keeps the previous valid route when no worthwhile improvement is found. Moat routes and routes with avoidance costs retain their existing behaviour. Updated setting tooltips explain the benefit and limits; enemy castles are not automatically avoided. Existing saved routes change only when a new route is calculated.

With fast group or individual routing enabled, newly calculated routes keep their direction for longer instead of zigzagging on almost every tile. Exact diagonals remain straight, and repeated sidesteps around small obstacles are reduced. Existing routes, including routes loaded from a save, change only when a new route is calculated.

Route checks do less unnecessary work, especially for units restricted to ground routes. Updated setting tooltips explain the benefits of shared group routes and fast individual searches, along with their limits.

Conflicts with other mods that change the same spot in the game's code are now detected: the affected feature stays off instead of overwriting the other mod's change, and the log names the conflict. Spots that a mod loaded later overwrites are reported in the log at each game start.

New option "Keep enemies off lowered drawbridges at gatehouses" (on by default): enemy soldiers and AI lords no longer plan routes onto a lowered drawbridge in front of your gatehouse or through it into your castle, even when another way into the castle exists. You, your allies and anyone who captured the gate keep using the bridge through the open gate. While the gate is closed but its bridge is still down, your own units cannot cross that bridge either if it is their only way.

With fast group or individual routing enabled, troops now also walk straight lines around larger obstacles, walls and moats instead of angular L-shaped detours. A straightened route is never longer or slower than before, and some group routes become slightly shorter.
Updated the tooltips of the shared group routing and fast individual search options accordingly.
Building, besieging or destroying a gatehouse and raising siege ladders no longer slow the game down for several seconds when many units are on the map.

With fast group or individual routing enabled, troops on open ground now favour direct routes instead of long right-angle detours. Small obstacles can be passed with short sidesteps; larger obstacles and moat crossings retain the previous routing.
Direct ground routes need less calculation, which can help reduce pauses when many units receive move orders.
Rewritten setting tooltips explain how shared group routing and fast individual searches can reduce stutters, which options are required and where their limits remain.

Stop treating stockpile platforms as walls for improved Assassin climbing. Assassins use the Keep entrance instead of instantly climbing its side from a nearby stockpile; ordinary wall connections and gatehouse climbing remain available. Requires APIShared 0.53.0.

Keep mounted troops and affected siege engines on suitable surfaces when finding individual and shared group routes, including when fast individual searches are disabled. Foot troops retain their usable wall and stair routes. Existing saved routes are not automatically repaired.
Keep native route results and memory-limit fallbacks identical across different worker counts for multiplayer.
Preserve the Pathfinding settings and author rules moved from BugfixesAndQoL in older saves, maps and trails. Newly added routing features stay off for migrated missions. Requires APIShared 0.51.0.
Clarify which movement settings affect human commands, AI troops and moat traversal.
Use shared validation for building lookups; require APIShared 0.49.0. Gameplay rules and settings are unchanged.
Reduce recurring work when checking the map for changes that affect unit paths.
Restore translated formation names and the settings reset button in every supported language.
Avoid temporary allocations while waiting for queued movement and remove an unused deferred-move context that retained old commands.
Keep unchanged gate routing policies cached in normal builds and calculate protected-center placement much faster for deep formations.
Refresh gatehouse reachability between native query passes, including loads and editor work that share the same game timestamp.
Preserve the previous settings when migration files cannot be read or written, including explicit changes made before an import can finish.
Accept multiplayer Assassin climbing and formation commands only from the verified player who controls the affected mode or owns the troop group.
Report BugfixesAndQoL versions older than 1.0.215, which still contain the same movement features.
Prevent unreachable enemies from closing gates anywhere inside the active closing range, including extended ranges and distances measured from the gate center.
Require APIShared 0.46.0 or newer.
First standalone version, built from the movement features of BugfixesAndQoL and MoatMove. Runs alongside BugfixesAndQoL; the old MoatMove test mod must be removed.
